selected_model_weights.role: validation-selected app-preview checkpoint; unchanged official COCO weights

prior_ssdlite_weights.role: historical weaker trial, not deployment candidate

pretrained_weights.separate_license: No model-specific blanket license found in official SSDLite weight metadata; official TorchVision README warns of licenses/terms derived from training data. Software BSD license alone is not proof of all weight/data rights.
pretrained_weights.terms_fetch_note: Official COCO website source linked from cocodataset.org verified. Annotations are CC BY4.0; COCO does not own original image copyright and refers to Flickr terms. This is not a blanket grant covering every training image or derived weight use.

fine_tune_data.name: Visaitech Mixed-Traffic Vehicle Detection v0.1
fine_tune_data.attribution: Visaitech (2026). Visaitech Mixed-Traffic Vehicle Detection Dataset (v0.1), revision de35185262bda34c104a626f866bab9d9aaf67ed. Generic vehicle/pedestrian remapping and horizontal flips used for detector-head training.
fine_tune_data.class_remap_caveat: Source 2-wheeler merges bicycles/scooters/motorcycles, 3-wheeler includes rickshaws, 4-wheeler merges car/van/bus/truck. Training maps all to generic vehicle and preserves pedestrian separately. No independently validated COCO subtype accuracy is claimed.

fine_tune_data.name: TRANSSET v5 diagnostic
fine_tune_data.attribution: Gebre, T.; Blackston, Q.; Hashemi-Beni, L. TRANSSET, v5, Figshare, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.26082217.v5. Original boxes collapsed to generic vehicle for evaluation only; sample overlays added.
